title: Elden Ring Smithing Stone 8 Locations: Where to Find and Buy Them
description: Find Smithing Stone 8 locations in Elden Ring, where to buy them infinitely, which Bell Bearing unlocks them, and how many you need for +24.
body:
Smithing Stone [8] is the last regular Smithing Stone tier before the final Ancient Dragon upgrade. It is used to take standard weapons from +21 to +24.

The easiest long-term option is to unlock them at the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold. Defeat the Godskin Duo in Crumbling Farum Azula, give the Husks Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4], and Smithing Stone [8] becomes available to buy for 3,600 runes each.

If you only need a few before then, you can also pick them up in late-game areas such as Crumbling Farum Azula, Yelough Anix Tunnel and the Consecrated Snowfield.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: Elden Ring map of Crumbling Farum Azula marked with multiple Smithing Stone 8 pickup locations.
imageCredit: Screenshot: SegmentNext / Bandai Namco Entertainment / FromSoftware.

contentBlocks.text:
Once you have **Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]**, the **Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold** sell Smithing Stone [8] for **3,600 runes each**.

This is the most convenient source if you are upgrading more than one weapon, because the shop stock is unlimited. A full set of 12 stones for one weapon costs 43,200 runes.

The shop unlock also carries into New Game Plus, so you do not need to collect the Bell Bearing again on your next journey.
contentBlocks.heading: Where to buy Smithing Stone 8

contentBlocks.text:
**Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] drops from the Godskin Duo in Crumbling Farum Azula.** The fight is on the main route through the area, so you cannot permanently miss the Bell Bearing.

After defeating the duo:

1. Pick up **Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]**.
2. Return to **Roundtable Hold**.
3. Give it to the **Twin Maiden Husks**.
4. Smithing Stone [7] and Smithing Stone [8] will be added to their shop.

If you are not at Farum Azula yet, you can still find individual Smithing Stone [8] pickups elsewhere and finish a few upgrade steps before unlocking the shop.
contentBlocks.heading: How to get Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 4

contentBlocks.text:
You can find Smithing Stone [8] in several late-game areas before you unlock unlimited purchases.

**Crumbling Farum Azula:** There are multiple Smithing Stone [8] pickups throughout the area. Since the Godskin Duo and Bell Bearing [4] are also here, this is usually where the material stops feeling scarce.

**Yelough Anix Tunnel:** This tunnel in the Consecrated Snowfield is one of the best places to collect several at once. You can pick up multiple stones inside, and the miner enemies can also drop them.

**Consecrated Snowfield:** More Smithing Stone [8] pickups are scattered around the region, including near Yelough Anix Ruins.

**Caelid:** One can also be reached near the Church of the Plague by using a nearby Spiritspring to get onto the rock formation holding the item.

These pickups are most useful when you only need a few stones and have not reached the Bell Bearing yet.
contentBlocks.caption: Yelough Anix Tunnel contains several Smithing Stone [8] pickups and is one of the strongest places to collect the material directly. Screenshot: GameWith; Elden Ring © Bandai Namco Entertainment / FromSoftware.
contentBlocks.heading: Best Smithing Stone 8 locations before the shop unlock
contentBlocks.imageAlt: A Smithing Stone 8 pickup glows inside the icy Yelough Anix Tunnel in Elden Ring.

contentBlocks.text:
A standard weapon needs **12 Smithing Stone [8] items** to move through the entire final regular-stone tier:

| Upgrade | Smithing Stone [8] needed |
| --- | ---: |
| +21 → +22 | 2 |
| +22 → +23 | 4 |
| +23 → +24 | 6 |
| **Total** | **12** |

After +24, the final +25 upgrade requires **one Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone**.

If you are still deciding which weapon deserves the materials, Neural Critic's [Elden Ring early-game progression guide](/stories/elden-ring-early-progression-what-to-upgrade-first/) explains why it is usually better to strengthen one setup you already like rather than spread upgrades across everything you find.
contentBlocks.caption: A standard weapon needs 12 Smithing Stone [8] items to cover the +22, +23 and +24 upgrade steps. Neural Critic gameplay screenshot.
contentBlocks.heading: How many Smithing Stone 8 do you need?
contentBlocks.imageAlt: The Elden Ring blacksmith menu shows a standard weapon upgrade and the Smithing Stone materials required.

contentBlocks.text:
Yes. The miner enemies in **Yelough Anix Tunnel** can drop Smithing Stone [8], so you can farm them if you need more.

Once you have Bell Bearing [4], though, farming is rarely worth the time. Buying the stones from the Twin Maiden Husks is faster and much more predictable.
contentBlocks.heading: Can you farm Smithing Stone 8?

contentBlocks.text:
Smithing Stone [8] is only used for weapons that follow the **standard +25 upgrade path**.

Unique and special weapons use **Somber Smithing Stones** instead. If your upgrade screen asks for Somber Smithing Stone [9], regular Smithing Stone [8] will not work.

For that material, see Neural Critic's [Somber Smithing Stone 9 locations guide](/stories/elden-ring-somber-smithing-stone-9-locations/). If you are still learning how Elden Ring's upgrade systems fit together, our [Elden Ring beginner's guide](/stories/elden-ring-beginners-guide/) covers the broader basics.
contentBlocks.heading: Smithing Stone 8 vs. Somber Smithing Stone 9

quickRead: Smithing Stone [8] upgrades standard weapons from +21 to +24; you need 12 stones for all three upgrade steps.
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] drops from the Godskin Duo in Crumbling Farum Azula and unlocks unlimited Smithing Stone [7] and [8] purchases.
Twin Maiden Husks sell Smithing Stone [8] for 3,600 runes each after you hand over the Bell Bearing.
conclusion:
If you only need one or two Smithing Stone [8] items, grab the loose pickups in places like Crumbling Farum Azula or Yelough Anix Tunnel. If you are upgrading several standard weapons, getting Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] is much easier because it gives you unlimited access at Roundtable Hold.

You need 12 Smithing Stone [8] items to take one standard weapon from +21 to +24. The final +25 upgrade uses an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone instead.
